name: Ken Thompson
summary: Computer scientist who developed Unix and the ed(1) text editor at Bell Labs.

name: Bell Laboratories
summary: Research and development arm of AT&T where Unix was created.

summary: Telecommunications corporation that owned Bell Laboratories.

summary: Unix line editor developed by Ken Thompson.

name: Unix
summary: Operating system developed at Bell Labs.

name: QED

name: Dennis Ritchie
summary: Computer scientist who collaborated with Thompson on Unix.

summary: Computer scientist and colleague at Bell Labs.

name: Kai Prenger
summary: Author of the thesis examining ed(1).
